description: This file defines the class TimedObjectDestructor, which is used in Unity projects to automatically destroy a game object after a specified time interval.

classes.name: TimedObjectDestructor
classes.description: A MonoBehaviour that destroys its game object after a specified timeout, optionally detaching children before destruction.

methods.name: Awake
methods.description: Initializes the object by scheduling its destruction after m_TimeOut seconds.

methods.name: DestroyNow
methods.description: Detaches child objects if specified, then destroys the game object.
